title: Slovakian Keto Skillet
description: A flavorful Slovakian dish with a twist, made keto-friendly. The skillet is cooked to perfection with a variety of ingredients for a delicious meal.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the bacon and cook until crispy. Remove from the skillet and set aside.
Add the onion and garlic to the skillet and cook until softened.
Add the mushrooms and cook until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the Slovakian sausage and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Stir in the sunflower seeds and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Return the bacon to the skillet and stir to combine.
Stir in the sour cream and cook for 1-2 minutes, until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with parsley if desired.
Let the dish rest for 5 minutes before serving.
